description: Glob `*` source crosses path segments — reference's `sourceMatches` at serve-handler/src/index.js:38-67 pre-substitutes `*` with `(.*)` then calls `pathToRegExp`, so `/dir/*` matches both `/dir/page` (one segment) and `/dir/sub/page` (multi segment). Locks the redirect-side of this behavior so a future regression on the `*`-source routing classifier shows up in the oracle. Closes Codex round 1 P1.
